Mail.ru, the Russian e-mail and portal company. Naspers' Jan 2007 filing says it bought 30% of the private company from Digital Sky Technologies and Tiger Global, 'who remain shareholders', so Tiger held it while private; the round Tiger entered is not named (stage undetermined). The company was folded into Digital Sky Technologies, renamed Mail.ru Group in 2010 and VK in 2021, so the original company reads acquired (successor-entity ambiguity, §6).
